information_unit.interpretation: completed cumulative-state differences define unsigned activity; only completed Price change defines direction
information_unit.explicitly_prohibited_interpretation: USDC/WETH as pool balances or signed amount0/amount1 inventory flow
information_unit.availability: completed UTC five-minute bucket end plus 120 seconds
information_unit.event_threshold: fit-only max(5,000,000 USDC increment, 99.5th percentile of positive five-minute USDC increments)
event_requirements: both frozen ETHUSDT external-liquidity pools at least 12bp from entry

model.calibration: one isotonic map only when calibration has >=50 resolved labels and both classes; otherwise raw probability

execution.entry: first exact contiguous five-minute open strictly after decision availability
execution.target_stop: nearest still-unconsumed confirmed two-left/two-right 15-minute swing high and low from prior 14 days, frozen before entry
execution.funding: historical Bybit funding when complete, otherwise adverse 1bp per eight-hour boundary

action.rule: choose the larger strictly positive action; otherwise FLAT

minimal_progression.confirmation_required: at least 50 resolved labels and both classes; no prediction metric is an opening barrier
minimal_progression.development_cost_possibility: positive 24bp total return, at least 20 completed trades and no forced liquidation

risk_search_after_cost_possibility.selection: highest 24bp geometric daily growth among no-liquidation paths; 1% is not a cap

minimal_progression.official_rule: freeze the highest-growth pre-2024 path and open 2024H1 immediately; structurally distant 2024H1 retires the information unit
